decision.reasoning_trace: During this shopping session, I narrowed down the 25 products to a consideration set of five backpacks that vary from ultralight packable options to heavy-duty tactical and internal frame packs. I specifically ignored non-backpack items like sleeping pads, tents, and rain covers. Among the backpacks, the HIKPRO 20L (prod_backpacks_006) was the most compelling choice because of its high rating (4.7) across nearly 3,000 reviews and its proven durability for a variety of uses like travel and light hiking, all at a very competitive price of $17.99. While the High Sierra Pathway was a strong contender for serious trekking, the HIKPRO offers the best utility-to-price ratio for my current needs.
